subject: VM Evidence: CVE SLAs & scan cadence — proof points and handoff
messages:
From: security@fintrust.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: prod-security@acme-payments.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC2 review

Hi Rishi / Laura,

As we prepare for FinTrust's SOC2 refresh next month, the audit team asked for a compact package that covers:
- scan cadence (tools and frequency),
- recent scan snapshot (last full infra scan),
- CVE remediation SLA tiers and a short example of a recently closed high/critical CVE,
- ownership matrix for triage/escalation.

Can you provide: a single-page summary we can share with auditors, the latest scan export (CSV is fine), and a one-paragraph attestation we can include in the SIG/CUSTOMER evidence folder that states Redwood's SLAs and typical closure timelines?

Deadline: May 15 (auditor has requested materials by COB PT).

Thanks,
Maya Singh
FinTrust Security
security@fintrust.com

--
Attachment request: please include filenames in your reply rather than the raw export in email.
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: security@fintrust.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: RE: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC2 review

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up. We can get you a compact package by the 15th. High level plan and attachments below:

Summary (one pager): attached as "vm-sla-attestation-draft.docx" — this includes our SLA tiers and example timelines.
Recent scan export: attached as "scan-snapshot-2028-05-09.csv" (full Nessus/Qualys export sanitized to remove IPs for public sharing).
Ownership matrix: attached as "cve-ownership-matrix-2028-05.xlsx" — maps internal teams, escalation contacts, and SLA buckets.

Key proof points (TL;DR):
- Continuous authenticated scans nightly across infra + weekly credentialed app scans.
- SLA buckets: Critical (CVE with exploitable public RCE) = 7 days to remediation + mitigation plan; High = 30 days; Medium = 90 days (config/patch backlog).
- Recent example: CVE-2028-34567 (root cause: outdated third-party lib) — detected 2028-04-20, mitigation (WAF rule) applied 2028-04-22, full vendor patch rolled 2028-05-02 (owner: infra-patching@redwood.ai).

Next steps: Laura and Marissa will validate the language for SOC2-specific wording and add an explicit attestation sentence for SIG. I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive folder and share the link below.

Attachments: scan-snapshot-2028-05-09.csv; cve-ownership-matrix-2028-05.xlsx; vm-sla-attestation-draft.docx

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
rm@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: security@fintrust.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:27:00 +0000
Subject: RE: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC2 review

Maya / team — adding a few clarifying points for the auditor-facing attestation:

1) SLA language: we'll include a clear statement that our CVE prioritization follows CVSS + exploit maturity, and that the stated timelines are the target for resolution or documented mitigations (we avoid "guarantees" but will attest to the operational process).
2) Exceptions: for third-party vendor fixes where we must wait on a vendor patch, we include compensating controls and a documented mitigation plan within the same SLA window.
3) Evidence folder: I'll drop a one-page "ProofPoints" PDF that lists the scan cadence schedule, the triage playbook version, and a short timeline for CVE-2028-34567.

Rishi — small edit request for the draft attestation: add the explicit line: "Redwood Inference attests that for newly-discovered critical vulnerabilities we implement mitigations within 7 days and track remediation to closure in our ticketing system." I captured that in the attached draft.

Marissa / Monica — please confirm the attachment names below match what you will upload to Drive. I'll approve final wording once uploads are complete.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: security@fintrust.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 15:45:00 +0000

Hi Laura / Rishi — this pack looks good, thank you. A couple of small asks before we close:
- Can you send a signed copy of the one-paragraph attestation (PDF) we can include in the audit checklist? A simple signature block from an executive or head of security is fine.
- Please place the scan CSV and the ownership spreadsheet into the shared Drive link and confirm the final filenames.

If possible, we prefer the signed attestation by Monday morning (May 15 PT) so the auditor can ingest it.

Acknowledged on the CVE example timeline — that's exactly what we needed.

Thanks again,
Maya Singh
FinTrust Security
security@fintrust.com
